report:
Fresh complete review of meta.reviews.input_format after coverage fixes. Consumed the current complete claim, the whole associated review.rs implementation, and all seven current ordinary annotated test functions. Recaptured Fixture, constants, imports and helper definitions via review read crates/sage-meta/tests/review.rs --lines 1 115, and check.rs to inspect the new ensure_valid call. The production file is byte-identical to the earlier inspected snapshot; the current associated tests were reassessed against the full claim. No TODO/N/A implementation or test entries apply to this anchor; placeholder cases below are tested inputs, not deferred coverage.

Implementation: ReviewInput declares prompt, ordered coordinator_instructions, uniform fragments, implementations and tests. inventory sets the exact PROMPT, constructs claim/whole-implementation-file/test-body InputFragments, copies all implementation and test association metadata, sorts and deduplicates association entries, and returns those five fields. start copies additional instructions without reordering and persists the input. capture_read appends the same InputFragment representation and persists it; initial context and later reads coexist. Source content is in fragments, with association identity/status separately represented. ReviewImplementation additionally retains its specified excerpt as navigation metadata. All relevant construction/persistence functions are within the associated whole implementation file. No missing implementation was found.

Complete associated test assessment: (1) initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments checks exact prompt, two ordered instructions including a newline, persisted/returned input equality, exact claim/implementation/test source, paths and initial counts. (2) input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection checks all implementation fields against fixture-derived expectations (crate, target, module, file, inherited cfg, meaningful excerpt, false region, ordinary status, absent explanation) and every test metadata field; it then asserts an extra read leaves association arrays and initial fragment prefix unchanged, adds exactly one fragment with exact content, and serializes exactly the five specified top-level keys. (3) region_association_preserves_placeholder_explanation_and_excerpt exercises true region, nested todo module identity, TODO status, prerequisite explanation and meaningful excerpt retention, including persistence. (4) test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement checks complete test identity/config/status and exact selected source with inherited cfg. (5) accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence checks both declared placeholder statuses and explanations survive, and that accepted reports preserve deferred/N/A classifications rather than claim ordinary approval. (6) added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments checks multiple test/implementation associations, stable test ordering, retained original metadata and invalidation on association changes. (7) whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits checks additional source reads, repeated fragments retained at the tail, exact CRLF/newline content and selected-content freshness. Together these explicit assertions cover all five fields, exact instructions, full metadata, declared status, and one common collection for initial and later context. Prior requested coverage edits are resolved.

Current delta reassessment: compared every fresh fragment and association to the prior reviewed input. The complete claim, whole review.rs, all association metadata, and five of seven test functions are unchanged. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits only gained a source_representation association. added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments gained a review_diagnostics association and replaced three bare invalidity assertions with ensure_valid().unwrap_err() plus assertions naming the anchor, association category, and review skill. The captured ensure_valid implementation returns an error exactly when is_valid is false, so these stronger assertions retain the original missing/added-association coverage while checking useful diagnostics. Recaptured fixture setup and helpers remain semantically unchanged; the prior line-range staleness came from adjacent added attributes. These deltas do not weaken the complete-field and shared-fragment coverage described above. No production defect or test adequacy gap was found; all earlier requested edits remain resolved.

Execution: personally ran cargo meta review start meta.reviews.input_format --instructions /tmp/sage-refresh-7.txt, read the fresh input and computed/inspected source deltas, and ran the two recorded reads described above. No Rust sources were edited and no tests, formatting check, or build were rerun in this refresh. The coordinator reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests, and workspace build passed; these are separately reported execution, not commands executed by this reviewer. Earlier personally executed formatting and earlier test reports are historical evidence only. This fresh approval rests on the current captured claim, implementation and complete test set.
